phases.title: Phase 0 — Baseline, tooling and gates in warn mode
phases.goal: Every number the later phases are judged against exists, every gate that will judge them runs (in warn mode) on the current UI, the parity baseline is frozen and diffable, and the deploy is a script. No user-visible change.

tasks.t: `scripts/verify-spec.mjs <spec>`: parse every task's **Verify** line, run each from the repo root with `DASH` and `RUN` exported, write raw stdout+exit to `.agent-team/$RUN/verify/<task>.log`, print `VERDICT: ship` or `VERDICT: fix:[ids]`; `--dry-run` lists the commands.

`scripts/budget.mjs`: gzip-9 of a route closure (`--route <entry>` = entry + statically imported chunks from `dist/manifest.json` + the esbuild metafile), `--chunk <name>`, `--file <name>`, `--fonts` (identity bytes), `--server` (sum of `infra/dashboard/{lite.mjs,routes/*,sse.mjs,static.mjs}`), `--legacy-app` (today's `infra/dashboard/app`, must reproduce 130 776 B); `--max <kb>` exits 1 over, `--warn` exits 0 and prints the overage.
tasks.e: ARCHITECTURE.md §9; MAP.md §6.2 C-1; ledger K-02, K-06

tasks.t: `scripts/lh-gate.mjs`: Lighthouse 13.5.0 (pinned devDependency), `--form-factor=mobile`, `--only-categories=performance`, `CHROME_PATH` resolved to Playwright's Chromium (never `/opt/google/chrome`, which is x86-64), `--max-wait-for-load=60000`, median of `--runs`, exit 1 if LCP > `--lcp` or TBT > `--tbt`, `--warn` exits 0; writes the JSON next to the log.

`scripts/parity-capture.mjs`: against `docs/qa/probes/fixture.sh` (fixed fleet, usage, host data), `Date.now` frozen by `addInitScript`, animations and caret off, capture every route (`/`, `/history`, `/system`, `/device`, `/agents`, `/agents/<fixture>`, `/agents/<fixture>/<run>`, `/s/<fixture>`, `/md?f=<fixture>`) at 390×844 DPR 3 and 1280×800 on WebKit and Chromium into `<out>/<engine>/<route>-<w>.png`; `--ui legacy|next` picks the document.
tasks.v: node scripts/parity-capture.mjs --ui legacy --out docs/qa/baseline/cockpit && test $(ls docs/qa/baseline/cockpit/webkit | wc -l) -ge 18

tasks.t: `scripts/parity-diff.mjs <baseDir> <newDir> [--route r] --max <pct>`: per-image differing-pixel percentage (pngjs + pixelmatch, devDependencies installed off-server), exit 1 if any image exceeds `--max`, `--warn` prints only; a self-diff is 0.

Gates take `UI_SRC` (default `infra/dashboard/app` now, `web` from phase 01): `scripts/chat-view-check.mjs`, `scripts/capability-check.mjs`, `scripts/chat-view-coverage.mjs`, `scripts/capability-coverage.mjs`, preflight 5c/5d/5e. Behaviour unchanged at the default.

phases.title: Phase 2a — The Sessions view at parity
phases.goal: The fleet view (`/`) in the shell: cards and rows at pixel parity, live over `fleet` events, every action and keyboard invariant preserved, prefetch and Back/Forward replacing prerender and bfcache.

tasks.t: `web/views/sessions.mjs`: rows (≥ 701 px) and cards (≤ 700 px) from the boot snapshot then `fleet` events; `data-state` and glyphs `◉ ● ⏸ ○`, words waiting/working/paused/idle, label = `label || proj || name`, sort needs-you < working < paused < idle then mtime, relative time re-rendered every 30 s, `#fleet-count`/`#fleet-empty`/`#pnav-live` semantics, reorder by moving nodes (keyed render).

Card menu: `<details name=fm>` exclusive menus, rename form (`/a/label`), pause/resume swap (`/a/pause`, `/a/resume`), kill confirm (`/a/kill`) — each a `<form method=post>` the view submits with `fetch` (same `back` field) and that still submits natively without JS; `form.busy` while in flight, cleared on response and on `pageshow`.
tasks.e: MAP.md §2.3.1 'Menu', §2.4 'Card menu behavior', §2.1 'Other base-script behaviors'; ledger K-19

tasks.t: Filter input (`[data-f=filter]`, substring over label+proj+snippet, `/` focuses it), digit keys 1–9 click the nth attach link (ignored inside inputs or with modifiers), `.fnum` badges on pointer:fine.

Attach links: `termHref('attach', name)` mints a fresh 8-hex tabid per render, `data-nw=t-<name>` becomes `target` only in browser display-mode at ≥ 700 px with a fine pointer; the `+ New Session` card and the FAB use `termHref('menu','')`.

Standalone-only behaviours: pull-to-refresh (`#ptr`, 56 px threshold, `location.reload()`), the `vpfix` re-measure loop (≤ 6 toggles, one reload per 30 s), top-anchored `.tabs`/`.termfab`; `#envout` diagnostic and the `/z?t=dash3` + `/z?t=vpfix` beacons.

Prefetch replaces prerender: on `pointerenter`/`touchstart` of a tab link the view's JSON (`/api/history?…`, `/api/system`, `/api/agents`) is fetched into the store, never for `/term*`, `fresh=1` or `reclaim=1` links; a later tap renders without a request.

Back/Forward replace bfcache: the store keeps the last list and scroll offset per route; `popstate` re-renders from the store with no request and restores the offset, including the scroll → Back → Forward → Back case the SPA left open.

tasks.t: `web/sw.mjs` → `/sw.js`: precache the shell document, `dist/` and `tokens.css` by manifest hash; answer navigations from cache only for `/`, `/history`, `/system`, `/device`, `/agents*`, `/s/*`; network-only for `/term*`, `/oauth2/*`, `/vnc/*`, `/droidview/*`, `/api/*`, `/stream`, `/events`, `/a/*`, `/md`; never cache a 3xx; the inline offline page kept; `skipWaiting` + `clients.claim` as today; `scripts/sw-check.mjs` loads the worker in a fake `ServiceWorkerGlobalScope` and asserts the allowlist, that a 3xx is never cached, that `/term/` is passed through, and the offline fallback body.

Badge: `navigator.setAppBadge(n)` with `n` = `needs-you` sessions from the `fleet` signal, `clearAppBadge()` on `focus`; `navigator.wakeLock.request('screen')` while any session is `working` and the tab is visible.

Push server: VAPID key pair generated once into the settings directory, `GET /api/push/key`, `POST`/`DELETE /api/push/subscribe` (same-origin, ≤ 4 KB, stored as JSON), sender in `sse.mjs` on a `needs-you` transition (debounced 30 s per session) implementing RFC 8291 aes128gcm + RFC 8292 VAPID on `node:crypto` with the declarative payload `{web_push: 8030, notification, app_badge}`; `scripts/push-check.mjs` encrypts to a generated key and decrypts with WebCrypto.
